items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: by and Margetts, Amit, Payton, Lewis and other different fellas

ctx.x: Some people told me in The Careless Love he plays at some of those same chords. Uh huh.

He'd be able to play just like Chris Kelly. But, you're right by and Margetts, Amit, Payton, Lewis and other different fellas, I guess that would spoil his lick. Hmm. Howard was a pretty good trumpet player.
Did the kid Howard ever play drums with you when you were playing with Chris?
